about: Sockets for IMAGE parts, placed by a person looking at the card on a 2x grid (card px). Not read by colour: on these cards the brad reader was off by up to 30px (head.threequarter_R neck read at 59,210; the ring is at 90,230). Every entry must be re-checked when its file changes: `size` is the file size the sockets were placed on, and the library refuses a part whose file no longer matches.
